craft_notes: Sthāyin: asserting sole power. Device: end-dash→comma (springing eased onto nodding). Rejected: 'nod' colloquial for 'beck' — killed: beck is older; kept. Rejected: splitting the dual (layodayau) — kept whole. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Lord, from thee solely, the sovran vigour springs uncloven,
at thy beck tri-worlds set and sink.
l4.sanskrit_cite: prabho bhavata eveha prabhuśaktir abhaṅgurā yadicchayā pratāyete trailokyasya layodayau

reads_against.argmap: O lord, from you alone here sovereign power unbroken.; By whose will the three worlds' dissolution and rise unfold. → From you alone unbroken power unfolds worlds' rise and fall.
c1_essence: Fist-caught, sight-caught, never slipped: drunk runners reach the Matted One.
reads_against.l2: Lord, from you only, unbroken sway holds here — at whose nod the three worlds fold and unfold.
